title: Guided kayak tour on the Schuylkill River with Hidden River Outfitters
intent: See the skyline and Fairmount Water Works from the water on a guided paddle.
description: Guided 90-minute flat-water tours leave from the Walnut Street dock on the Schuylkill Banks. Daytime tours start at $40, sunset and sunrise tours are about $45, and kayak-and-movie nights are around $40. The company has run fall-foliage tours in September and October.

place.name: Hidden River Outfitters (Walnut Street Dock)
place.address: Walnut St at the Schuylkill River, Philadelphia, PA 19106

uncertain: whether tours are still running this late in October; check the site for the end of the season
notes: harvest: Outdoor activities: kayaking, paddleboarding, rock climbing gyms, ice skating, roller rinks
